description: After reviewing a Supabase migration or ownership policy, optionally execute already reviewed local permissions scenarios for owner, other_user and anon. Returns Pass, Fail or Unknown per cell with the original scoped evidence. This is an experimental PGlite imitation, not live Supabase proof. The optional PGlite dependency must already be installed next to the matching CLI used by this local MCP host; missing setup returns the CLI setup guidance as a tool error. No SQL, credentials, provider calls or dependency installation are accepted.

cwd.description: Project root. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

matrix.description: Path to an already reviewed permissions JSON file, relative to cwd or absolute. Expectations must describe intended access.

migrations.description: Local migrations directory. Defaults to supabase/migrations under cwd.

name: viberaven_rls_test
